name: Age Differences In Relationship
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of significant age differences in relationships, as seen in Abraham and Sarah's advanced years when God promised them a child, demonstrating that divine possibilities transcend human expectations. Wisdom, symbolized as a builder of a strong and stable house, reminds believers to seek godly understanding rather than being swayed by superficial attraction or lust. Ultimately, Luke affirms that with God, nothing is impossible, encouraging trust in His sovereign plan regardless of age disparities or societal norms.
